From request to action in three steps.

Step 1

Add the Kanal MCP server to your assistant and link it to your Kanal account.

Step 2

Ask a question or give an instruction in plain language: measure a campaign, create a segment, prepare a send, build an automation.

The assistant acts in your Kanal account. For a campaign, it shows you the audience, the date and the estimated cost, then waits for your confirmation.
